api_checks.description: POST /loans/{loan_id}/disbursement → 201 — the loan record holds the released amount
GET /loans/{loan_id} → 200 — holds a funding_source and reads DISBURSED with its schedule attached
POST /loans/{loan_id}/disbursement → 201 — with the stub funding source; no external payment rail is called and no signed agreement artifact is produced
POST /loans/{loan_id}/disbursement → 409 — AlreadyDisbursed on the second attempt; the recorded released amount is unchanged
POST /operations/end-of-day → 200 — for a given as_of_date; each seeded loan's stored bucket matches its days past due at that date
POST /operations/end-of-day → 200 — a second run for the same as_of_date leaves every bucket and stored row byte-identical
POST /operations/end-of-day → 200 — for an as_of_date before a loan's first due date, that loan's bucket reads CURRENT
POST /operations/end-of-day → 200 — no fee, penal interest or collections record was created by the run
